quests.name: Meet Meriem
quests.summary: Meet Meriem at the airport entrance to begin the ranch introduction.
quests.zhSummary: 在机场入口与玛丽阿姆见面，开始牧场引导。

facts.text: Meet Meriem at the airport entrance.
facts.zhText: 在机场入口寻找玛丽阿姆。

facts.text: Configured for the farm owner; this is not a separate objective for every co-op visitor.
facts.zhText: 配置限定牧场主执行，不是每位联机访客都各做一次的目标。

facts.text: The success configuration starts A new begining!, the drive to your ranch.
facts.zhText: 成功配置衔接“新的开始！”，继续开车去牧场。

notes.text: Meet Meriem at the airport entrance.
notes.zhText: 在机场入口寻找玛丽阿姆。

notes.text: Configured for the farm owner; this is not a separate objective for every co-op visitor.
notes.zhText: 配置限定牧场主执行，不是每位联机访客都各做一次的目标。

notes.text: The success configuration starts A new begining!, the drive to your ranch.
notes.zhText: 成功配置衔接“新的开始！”，继续开车去牧场。

quests.name: A new begining!
quests.summary: Drive Meriam to your ranch and complete the introductory handover.
quests.zhSummary: 载玛丽阿姆回到牧场，并完成初次交接。

facts.text: Take the driver’s seat in Meriam’s car; being in the ranch area also satisfies this configured check.
facts.zhText: 坐上玛丽阿姆车辆的驾驶位；已经到牧场区域也符合此项配置判定。

facts.text: Wait for Meriam to board; the check also accepts reaching the ranch area.
facts.zhText: 等玛丽阿姆上车；判定也接受已经到达牧场区域。

facts.text: Drive to the ranch area.
facts.zhText: 把车开到牧场区域。

steps.text: Take the driver’s seat in Meriam’s car; being in the ranch area also satisfies this configured check.
steps.zhText: 坐上玛丽阿姆车辆的驾驶位；已经到牧场区域也符合此项配置判定。

steps.text: Wait for Meriam to board; the check also accepts reaching the ranch area.
steps.zhText: 等玛丽阿姆上车；判定也接受已经到达牧场区域。

steps.text: Drive to the ranch area.
steps.zhText: 把车开到牧场区域。

steps.text: At the ranch, both you and Meriam must leave the quest car.
steps.zhText: 到达牧场后，你和玛丽阿姆都需要离开任务车辆。

steps.text: Speak to Meriam. The inventory check requires a Bronze hammer, Red Tent and strawberry, at least one of each.
steps.zhText: 与玛丽阿姆交谈。背包判定要求 Bronze 品质的锤子、红色帐篷和草莓各至少一件。

notes.text: The final inventory check is a completion condition, not a verified reward list.
notes.zhText: 末尾背包检查是完成条件，不当作已验证的奖励清单。

notes.text: This introductory drive is configured for the farm owner.
notes.zhText: 该引导驾驶任务配置为牧场主执行。

quests.name: From Blueprint to Bed
quests.summary: Place the Red Tent blueprint, build it with a hammer and rest inside.
quests.zhSummary: 放下红色帐篷蓝图，用锤子建成后在里面休息。

facts.text: Equip the Red Tent blueprint; an already placed or built tent also satisfies the first check.
facts.zhText: 装备红色帐篷蓝图；已有已放置或建成的帐篷也符合第一项检查。

facts.text: Place the Red Tent blueprint.
facts.zhText: 放下红色帐篷蓝图。

facts.text: Use the hammer to finish building the tent; placement alone is not the completed-build check.
facts.zhText: 用锤子完成帐篷建造；只放下蓝图不等于建成。

steps.text: Equip the Red Tent blueprint; an already placed or built tent also satisfies the first check.
steps.zhText: 装备红色帐篷蓝图；已有已放置或建成的帐篷也符合第一项检查。

steps.text: Place the Red Tent blueprint.
steps.zhText: 放下红色帐篷蓝图。

steps.text: Use the hammer to finish building the tent; placement alone is not the completed-build check.
steps.zhText: 用锤子完成帐篷建造；只放下蓝图不等于建成。

steps.text: Sleep while the Red Tent is placed on the ranch.
steps.zhText: 红色帐篷已放置后进入睡眠。

notes.text: The quest checks the ordinary Red Tent ID, not the four-person tent.
notes.zhText: 任务检查普通红色帐篷的物品 ID，不是四人款。

quests.name: Axe, Pick & Welcome!
quests.summary: Find the axe and pickaxe, then prepare wood logs and stones.
quests.zhSummary: 找到斧头与镐，再准备原木和石头。

facts.text: Obtain at least one axe.
facts.zhText: 获得至少一把斧头。

facts.text: Obtain at least one pickaxe.
facts.zhText: 获得至少一把镐。

facts.text: Have at least 15 Wood Logs in your inventory.
facts.zhText: 背包中准备至少15根原木。

steps.text: Obtain at least one axe.
steps.zhText: 获得至少一把斧头。

steps.text: Obtain at least one pickaxe.
steps.zhText: 获得至少一把镐。

steps.text: Have at least 15 Wood Logs in your inventory.
steps.zhText: 背包中准备至少15根原木。

steps.text: Have at least 15 Stones in your inventory.
steps.zhText: 背包中准备至少15块石头。

notes.text: These checks count items in your inventory; they do not establish a fixed spawn coordinate for either tool.
notes.zhText: 这些条件检查背包物品数量，不能据此标出工具的精确刷新坐标。

notes.text: Victor’s introductory call points you toward his family’s stored tools.
notes.zhText: 任务说明中，维克多的引导电话会提示家中存放的旧工具。

quests.name: Drop & Earn, the next day!
quests.summary: Put items into the Cash-In box to start the selling tutorial.
quests.zhSummary: 向现金兑换箱放入物品，开始出售教学。

facts.text: The objective asks for Wood Logs and Stones in the Cash-In box; its configured condition checks whether the box has an item awaiting sale.
facts.zhText: 目标文字要求把原木和石头放进现金兑换箱；配置条件检查箱中是否有等待出售的物品。

facts.text: The condition checks pending sale contents, not received payment or a guaranteed selling price.
facts.zhText: 条件检查待售物品，不检查是否已到账，也不能证明出售价格。

facts.text: The success configuration continues to Next-Door Neighbors.
facts.zhText: 成功配置继续衔接“隔壁邻居”。

steps.text: The objective asks for Wood Logs and Stones in the Cash-In box; its configured condition checks whether the box has an item awaiting sale.
steps.zhText: 目标文字要求把原木和石头放进现金兑换箱；配置条件检查箱中是否有等待出售的物品。

notes.text: The condition checks pending sale contents, not received payment or a guaranteed selling price.
notes.zhText: 条件检查待售物品，不检查是否已到账，也不能证明出售价格。

notes.text: The success configuration continues to Next-Door Neighbors.
notes.zhText: 成功配置继续衔接“隔壁邻居”。

notes.text: This selling introduction is configured for the farm owner.
notes.zhText: 该出售引导配置为牧场主执行。

quests.name: Next-Door Neighbors
quests.summary: Meet Gigi and Scott, with watering-can and hoe checks for the farming introduction.
quests.zhSummary: 认识吉吉和斯科特，并检查种田引导需要的洒水壶与锄头。

facts.text: Meet Gigi and hold at least one Bronze Watering Can.
facts.zhText: 与吉吉见面，并持有至少一个 Bronze 品质洒水壶。

facts.text: Meet Scott and hold at least one Bronze Hoe.
facts.zhText: 与斯科特见面，并持有至少一把 Bronze 品质锄头。

facts.text: Conversation alone is not the entire configured condition: each meeting also checks its corresponding tool.
facts.zhText: 配置不仅检查见面，每一项还检查对应工具。

steps.text: Meet Gigi and hold at least one Bronze Watering Can.
steps.zhText: 与吉吉见面，并持有至少一个 Bronze 品质洒水壶。

steps.text: Meet Scott and hold at least one Bronze Hoe.
steps.zhText: 与斯科特见面，并持有至少一把 Bronze 品质锄头。

notes.text: Conversation alone is not the entire configured condition: each meeting also checks its corresponding tool.
notes.zhText: 配置不仅检查见面，每一项还检查对应工具。

notes.text: The success configuration continues to Seeds of Success.
notes.zhText: 成功配置衔接“成功的种子”。

configuredRewardActions.zhTriggerText: 完成 Gigi 的任务对话后
完成 Scott 的任务对话后

quests.name: Seeds of Success
quests.summary: Till, sow and water a field, then reach the configured planted-plot target.
quests.zhSummary: 翻地、播种、浇水，并达到配置中的播种地块目标。

facts.text: Return to the ranch area.
facts.zhText: 回到牧场区域。

facts.text: Equip the hoe; having an existing plantation also passes this check.
facts.zhText: 装备锄头；已有种植地也符合这一检查。

facts.text: Till the soil to create a planting area.
facts.zhText: 翻地，建立种植地块。

steps.text: Return to the ranch area.
steps.zhText: 回到牧场区域。

steps.text: Equip the hoe; having an existing plantation also passes this check.
steps.zhText: 装备锄头；已有种植地也符合这一检查。

steps.text: Till the soil to create a planting area.
steps.zhText: 翻地，建立种植地块。

steps.text: Put seeds in the prepared soil.
steps.zhText: 向准备好的土地播种。

steps.text: Water the seeded soil with the watering can.
steps.zhText: 用洒水壶浇灌已播种的土地。

steps.text: Have 16 seeded plots; the last objective and configured condition both use 16.
steps.zhText: 种满16块地；最后一条目标文字和配置判定都使用16。

notes.text: The introductory description says ten plots, but the last objective and condition use 16. Do not stop at ten based only on the description.
notes.zhText: 任务简介写10块，最后目标和判定写16块；不要只按简介种10块就停下。

quests.name: Feathered Foes
quests.summary: Craft and build a scarecrow, checking which variant the placement objective accepts.
quests.zhSummary: 制作并建造稻草人，注意放置目标接受的具体款式。

facts.text: Prepare one ordinary Scarecrow or Bob the Scarecrow; the first condition also accepts one already built.
facts.zhText: 准备一个普通稻草人或稻草人鲍勃；第一项也接受已经建好的相应物品。

facts.text: Build one ordinary Scarecrow. This second condition names only the ordinary variant.
facts.zhText: 建造一个普通稻草人；第二项配置只写普通款。

facts.text: The two checks accept different variants. Bob satisfies the first condition but is not listed in the final build condition.
facts.zhText: 前后两项接受的款式不同：鲍勃符合第一项，但未列在最后建造判定中。

steps.text: Prepare one ordinary Scarecrow or Bob the Scarecrow; the first condition also accepts one already built.
steps.zhText: 准备一个普通稻草人或稻草人鲍勃；第一项也接受已经建好的相应物品。

steps.text: Build one ordinary Scarecrow. This second condition names only the ordinary variant.
steps.zhText: 建造一个普通稻草人；第二项配置只写普通款。

notes.text: The two checks accept different variants. Bob satisfies the first condition but is not listed in the final build condition.
notes.zhText: 前后两项接受的款式不同：鲍勃符合第一项，但未列在最后建造判定中。

notes.text: The task introduction describes scarecrows as crop protection against birds; no protection radius is specified here.
notes.zhText: 任务简介将稻草人用于防鸟护田，但这里没有给出保护半径。

quests.name: Rust to Rumbling!
quests.zhName: Rust to Rumbling! 修车任务
quests.searchTags: rust rumbling victor old car 3000 bykii vehicle quest
quests.zhSearchTags: Rust to Rumbling Victor 旧车 3000 Bykii 汽车 任务
quests.summary: A current-build four-objective vehicle quest observed in the tracker on Day 5.
quests.zhSummary: 当前版本第 5 天任务追踪器中观测到的四目标车辆任务。

facts.text: The exact tracker title Rust to Rumbling! and a four-objective chain were observed in current-build footage.
facts.zhText: 当前版本画面中观测到任务追踪器的准确标题 Rust to Rumbling!，流程共四个目标。

facts.text: The first retained objective is to save 3,000 C before progressing the vehicle route.
facts.zhText: 保留画面显示首个目标是存下 3,000 C，再继续车辆流程。

facts.text: The observed chain includes repairing Victor's old car, using a Bykii terminal and collecting the replacement vehicle; exact dialogue choices were not retained.
facts.zhText: 观测流程包含修理 Victor 的旧车、使用 Bykii 终端并领取替换车辆；现有资料未保留所有对话选项。

buildGuide.name: Rust to Rumbling!
buildGuide.zhName: 从锈迹斑斑到轰鸣上路！

steps.text: Prepare 3,000 C; the configured check also accepts an already-repaired car.
steps.zhText: 准备至少 3,000 C；配置也接受已经修好的车。

steps.text: Repair Victor's old car.
steps.zhText: 修理 Victor 的旧车。

steps.text: Rent a bike from Bykii for the pickup trip; driving the repaired quest car also passes this check.
steps.zhText: 从 Bykii 租自行车去取车；已经开上修好的任务车也能通过此判定。

steps.text: Collect the repaired car and take the driver's seat.
steps.zhText: 取回修好的任务车并坐上驾驶位。

notes.text: The funds check is not a verified repair price or reward.
notes.zhText: 资金判定不等于已验证的修车价格或奖励。

quests.name: Power to the Bench
quests.zhName: Power to the Bench 工作台供电任务
quests.searchTags: power bench victor electricity contract 1000 city hall workbench quest
quests.zhSearchTags: Power to the Bench Victor 电力 通电 供电 合同 1000 市政厅 工作台 任务
quests.summary: A five-objective utility tutorial that connects City Hall, Victor's contract and the ranch workbench.
quests.zhSummary: 连接市政厅、Victor 电力合同和牧场工作台的五目标公用事业教程任务。

facts.text: The exact tracker title and five-objective route were observed on Day 8 in current-build footage.
facts.zhText: 当前版本第 8 天画面中观测到准确任务标题和五个目标。

facts.text: The observed route sends the player to City Hall and Victor to commission an electricity and gas contract before building the workbench.
facts.zhText: 观测流程要求玩家前往市政厅找 Victor 办理电力与燃气合同，然后建造工作台。

facts.text: Victor's retained dialogue states a 1,000 C commissioning fee, daily usage billing and city purchase of surplus power; it does not reveal a per-unit rate.
facts.zhText: 保留的 Victor 对话说明签约费为 1,000 C，按日结算用量，并可由城市回购余电；画面没有显示单位费率。

steps.text: Have 1,000 C available before starting the contract route.
steps.zhText: 先准备至少 1,000 C，再进行签约流程。

steps.text: Visit City Hall; the configured check also accepts an existing electricity contract.
steps.zhText: 前往市政厅；配置也接受已经签订的用电合同。

steps.text: Arrange the electricity contract with Victor.
steps.zhText: 找 Victor 办理用电合同。

steps.text: Build a workbench at the ranch, not just its blueprint.
steps.zhText: 在牧场建好工作台，只有蓝图还不够。

steps.text: Open the phone's energy meter app to check usage.
steps.zhText: 打开手机的电表应用，查看牧场能耗。

notes.text: The last objective checks whether the energy app is open; building the workbench alone does not satisfy that step.
notes.zhText: 最后一步检查的是电表应用是否打开，不是工作台是否建成。

configuredRewardActions.zhTriggerText: 完成 Scott 的结束对话后

quests.name: Roof-building tutorial objective
quests.searchTags: roof quest tracker stuck tutorial door window cap workbench
quests.zhSearchTags: 屋顶 任务 追踪器 卡住 教程 门 窗 Roof Cap 工作台
quests.summary: A descriptive entry for the roof-building objective because the exact tracker title is not retained.
quests.zhSummary: 屋顶建造目标的描述性条目，因为现有证据没有保留准确任务标题。

facts.text: Official support confirmed a known state where the roof objective is built but its tracker does not advance.
facts.zhText: 官方支持确认存在屋顶已经建好但任务追踪器不推进的已知状态。

facts.text: The official recovery sequence is to inspect the phone quest journal with T, sleep to the next day and restart the client if the tracker remains stuck.
facts.zhText: 官方恢复顺序是按 T 检查手机任务日志、睡到第二天，并在追踪器仍卡住时重启客户端。

facts.text: Separate community cases involve hidden workbench rows, missing door/window placement or a Roof Cap opening; use the decision guide instead of treating every symptom as the tracker bug.
facts.zhText: 另一些社区案例来自工作台列表未滚动、门窗未放置或 Roof Cap 中央开口；应使用分类流程，而不是把所有症状都当成追踪器故障。

steps.text: Craft and place a storage chest.
steps.zhText: 制作并放好储物箱。

steps.text: Build at least nine house foundations.
steps.zhText: 至少建好 9 个房屋地基。

steps.text: Build at least nine standard exterior wall sections.
steps.zhText: 至少建好 9 段普通外墙。

steps.text: Build at least two window-wall sections.
steps.zhText: 至少建好 2 段窗墙。

steps.text: Install two windows, in addition to the window walls.
steps.zhText: 另外安装 2 扇窗户，窗墙不能代替窗户。

steps.text: Build an exterior wall section with a doorway.
steps.zhText: 建好至少 1 段门墙。

steps.text: Install the door itself.
steps.zhText: 安装门本身，只有门墙还不够。

steps.text: Build a doorstep.
steps.zhText: 建好门口台阶。

steps.text: Complete the roof.
steps.zhText: 建好屋顶。

steps.text: Craft and place a bed.
steps.zhText: 制作并放好床。

notes.text: Window walls and windows have separate checks, as do doorway walls and doors. Check for missing pieces before using the roof-tracker recovery guide.
notes.zhText: 窗墙与窗户、门墙与门分别检查；先确认没有漏装，再按屋顶任务排查处理。

quests.name: A Ride and a Revelation
quests.summary: Meet Gigi and Chris at NovaGen, visit Leafy Market, then take Gigi home.
quests.zhSummary: 在诺瓦基因见吉吉与克里斯，前往绿叶市场后送吉吉回家。

facts.text: Go to the NovaGen area.
facts.zhText: 前往诺瓦基因区域。

facts.text: Complete the first conversation with Gigi.
facts.zhText: 完成与吉吉的第一次交谈。

facts.text: Speak with Chris.
facts.zhText: 与克里斯交谈。

steps.text: Go to the NovaGen area.
steps.zhText: 前往诺瓦基因区域。

steps.text: Complete the first conversation with Gigi.
steps.zhText: 完成与吉吉的第一次交谈。

steps.text: Speak with Chris.
steps.zhText: 与克里斯交谈。

steps.text: Speak with Gigi again.
steps.zhText: 再次与吉吉交谈。

steps.text: Enter Leafy Market.
steps.zhText: 进入绿叶市场。

steps.text: Buy more seeds. The condition checks a seed-category inventory count greater than two, not a purchase receipt.
steps.zhText: 购买更多种子。条件检查种子类别背包计数大于2，不是检查购物票据。

steps.text: Take Gigi back to her ranch area.
steps.zhText: 把吉吉送回她的牧场区域。

steps.text: Complete the final goodbye conversation.
steps.zhText: 完成最后的道别交谈。

notes.text: The objective order visits Leafy Market before the home drop-off, even though the introductory description mentions them in the opposite order.
notes.zhText: 目标列表先去绿叶市场再送回家，和任务简介中的叙述顺序不同。

notes.text: The success configuration continues to Seed Capital.
notes.zhText: 成功配置衔接“种子本金计划”。

quests.name: Seed Capital
quests.summary: Reach the planted-field and account-balance targets together.
quests.zhSummary: 同时达到播种地块和账户余额目标。

facts.text: Have at least 32 seeded plots.
facts.zhText: 拥有至少32块已播种的土地。

facts.text: Have at least 10,500 C in your account.
facts.zhText: 账户中拥有至少10,500 C。

facts.text: The balance check is a target, not a purchase cost or reward.
facts.zhText: 余额检查是目标，不是购买费用或奖励。

steps.text: Have at least 32 seeded plots.
steps.zhText: 拥有至少32块已播种的土地。

steps.text: Have at least 10,500 C in your account.
steps.zhText: 账户中拥有至少10,500 C。

notes.text: The balance check is a target, not a purchase cost or reward.
notes.zhText: 余额检查是目标，不是购买费用或奖励。

notes.text: The field target counts seeded plots, not harvested crops or harvest income.
notes.zhText: 农田目标检查已播种地块，不是收获数量或出售收入。

quests.name: Chicken Coop Mission
quests.zhName: 养鸡场任务 Chicken Coop Mission
quests.searchTags: chicken coop mission angela buy pickup field boot stuck prompt
quests.zhSearchTags: 养鸡 鸡舍 任务 Angela 买鸡 围栏 后备箱 卡住 提示
quests.summary: Community label for the early chicken-purchase objective; the exact in-game tracker title is not retained.
quests.zhSummary: 社区对早期买鸡目标的称呼；现有资料没有保留准确的游戏内任务标题。

facts.text: Players complete the purchase step through Angela, the chicken seller.
facts.zhText: 玩家通过卖鸡商人 Angela 完成购买步骤。

facts.text: Bought chickens spawn in the fenced field behind her house instead of entering inventory; grab them and use a car boot or carry them home.
facts.zhText: 买到的鸡会生成在她屋后的围栏地里，不会进入背包；需要抱起后装进汽车后备箱或步行带回。

facts.text: Every retained stuck case came from missing the post-purchase prompt, but that pattern does not rule out other mission bugs.
facts.zhText: 现有卡住案例都源于漏看购买后的提示，但这不能排除任务存在其他故障。

steps.text: Collect 15 stone.
steps.zhText: 收集 15 块石头。

steps.text: Collect 20 wood logs.
steps.zhText: 收集 20 根原木。

steps.text: Collect 15 hay.
steps.zhText: 收集 15 捆干草。

steps.text: Have at least 5,760 C available.
steps.zhText: 准备至少 5,760 C。

steps.text: Buy the coop blueprint from Meriam.
steps.zhText: 找 Meriam 购买鸡舍蓝图。

steps.text: Finish building the coop.
steps.zhText: 建好鸡舍。

steps.text: Visit Angela's ranch.
steps.zhText: 前往 Angela 的牧场。

steps.text: Buy at least two hens; this check requires female chickens.
steps.zhText: 购买至少 2 只母鸡；配置检查的是雌性鸡。

steps.text: Put two hens in the coop; ownership alone is not enough.
steps.zhText: 把 2 只母鸡放进鸡舍；仅仅拥有它们还不够。

notes.text: 5,760 C is a funds threshold, not a verified blueprint price or shopping total.
notes.zhText: 5,760 C 是资金门槛，不是已验证的蓝图售价或采购总价。

notes.text: The overview mentions a rooster, but purchase and housing checks specifically require two hens.
notes.zhText: 概述提到公鸡，但购买和入舍判定具体要求的是 2 只母鸡。

quests.name: Solar panel objective
quests.searchTags: solar panel quest ground roof basic electricity objective stuck
quests.zhSearchTags: 太阳能板 任务 地面 屋顶 基础款 电力 目标 卡住
quests.summary: Community label for the objective that distinguishes the basic ground panel from the roof version.
quests.zhSummary: 社区对该目标的称呼；关键是区分基础地面太阳能板和屋顶版本。

facts.text: Two players independently confirmed that the objective needs the basic ground solar panel.
facts.zhText: 两名玩家相互确认，该目标需要基础地面太阳能板。

facts.text: The roof solar panel does not satisfy this objective even though it is also a solar panel.
facts.zhText: 屋顶太阳能板虽然也是太阳能板，但不会满足该任务目标。

facts.text: The retained confirmations say one correctly placed ground panel is sufficient; exact quest title and prerequisite timing remain unverified.
facts.zhText: 现有确认称正确放置一个地面款即可；准确任务标题和前置触发时间仍未验证。

steps.text: Open the phone's energy meter and inspect daily usage.
steps.zhText: 打开手机电表，查看每天的用电量。

steps.text: Buy solar panel blueprints from Meriam for the panels you need.
steps.zhText: 找 Meriam 购买所需的太阳能板蓝图。

steps.text: Place and finish building the panels.
steps.zhText: 放置太阳能板并完成建造。

steps.text: Check that the ranch meets the electricity-efficiency objective.
steps.zhText: 检查牧场是否达成用电效率目标。

notes.text: The final check is electricity efficiency, not simply owning one panel. This configuration gives no fixed panel count or numeric efficiency target.
notes.zhText: 最后检查的是牧场用电效率，不只是拥有一块板；此处配置没有给出固定板数或具体效率数值。

notes.text: Earlier player reports recommend the basic ground panel. The build checks a solar-item family; this alone does not verify that roof panels work.
notes.zhText: 较早的玩家互证推荐基础地面款。构建中检查的是太阳能物品系列，单凭它不能确认屋顶款是否适用。

quests.name: Real Eggs, Real Evidence
quests.zhName: Real Eggs, Real Evidence 大鸡蛋任务
quests.searchTags: real eggs evidence gigi large egg police chase quest end
quests.zhSearchTags: Real Eggs Real Evidence Gigi 大鸡蛋 警察 追逐 任务 结尾
quests.summary: The current large-egg route involving Gigi, a police escape and the present end of the implemented quest line.
quests.zhSummary: 当前涉及 Gigi、大鸡蛋、逃离警察以及现有任务线终点的流程。

facts.text: An official moderator reply identifies the two-egg hand-in as the end of the main questline for now; this does not catalogue optional or unrelated quests.
facts.zhText: 官方版主回复确认，交付两枚鸡蛋后当前主线暂时结束；这不等于已经编目所有可选或无关任务。

facts.text: The retained current route requires two Large Eggs; daily care and enclosed outdoor roaming affect the chance, but the result remains random.
facts.zhText: 现有当前流程要求两个大鸡蛋；每日照料和封闭室外活动会影响机会，但产出仍具有随机性。

facts.text: After handoff, Gigi follows the player during a police escape and must be returned to her home area to complete the documented route.
facts.zhText: 交付后，Gigi 会在逃离警察期间跟随玩家，需要被送回她家附近才能完成已记录流程。

facts.text: Multiple players report no implemented follow-up after the return; waiting additional seasons is not a verified solution.
facts.zhText: 多名玩家报告送回后没有已实装的后续；继续等待多个季节不是已验证解法。

buildGuide.name: Real Eggs, Real Evidence!
buildGuide.zhName: 真正的鸡蛋，确凿的证据！

steps.text: Collect two large chicken eggs from your coop.
steps.zhText: 从鸡舍收集 2 个大鸡蛋。

steps.text: Meet Gigi and finish the first quest conversation.
steps.zhText: 见到 Gigi，完成第一次任务对话。

steps.text: Lose the police pursuit.
steps.zhText: 甩掉警察追捕。

steps.text: Return Gigi to her home area after escaping.
steps.zhText: 脱离追捕后，把 Gigi 送回家附近。

steps.text: Speak to Gigi again to finish the final conversation check.
steps.zhText: 再次与 Gigi 交谈，完成最后的对话判定。

notes.text: The overview says 12 eggs, but both the objective and inventory check require 2 large chicken eggs. Follow the specific objective.
notes.zhText: 概述写了 12 个鸡蛋，但具体目标和背包判定都要求 2 个大鸡蛋；按具体目标准备，不要被概述误导。

notes.text: Returning home is not the last step: the final conversation and escape checks must both pass.
notes.zhText: 送回家不是最后一步：结束对话和脱离追捕两个判定都要满足。

configuredRewardActions.zhTriggerText: 交付 2 个大号鸡蛋后
